name: Puffco | Proxy Core | Onyx
description:
The new Proxy Core is engineered for daily life – maximum portability, uncompromising power.

Driven by our patented 3D Chamber and the Puffco Connect app’s deep customization, Core delivers full spectrum flavor and impressive clouds in a glass-free, highly pocketable form. And when you combine the ceramic terp pearls with Core's impact airpath design, you’re getting a direct, intimate hit that rumbles as you inhale.
